title: How to Cancel Jetts NZ Membership — Step-by-Step 2026
meta_desc: How to cancel your Jetts gym membership in New Zealand. Simple steps, no lock-in complexity — Jetts is one of the easiest gyms to cancel in NZ.
intro: Jetts is one of the easiest gym memberships to cancel in New Zealand. There's no long-term lock-in contract — just a notice period. You don't need to justify your cancellation, pay an exit fee, or negotiate with anyone. Here's the simple process.

rows: Via the Jetts member portal or in person at your club
Cancel after confirmation of membership end

sections.heading: How to Cancel Jetts NZ
sections.body:
Because Jetts has no lock-in contract, cancellation is straightforward:

1. **Log into the Jetts member portal** (app or website) and submit a cancellation request. This is the easiest method.
2. **Alternatively**, visit your Jetts club in person and request cancellation in writing.
3. You'll receive confirmation of your cancellation and your final payment date.
4. Continue using the club until your final payment date — your access remains active through the notice period.
5. Cancel your direct debit via online banking after your final payment has processed.

sections.heading: Notice Period
sections.body: Jetts typically requires 10–14 days notice. This means if you cancel today, you'll be charged for approximately 2 more weeks and your membership remains active during that period. Confirm the exact notice period in your membership agreement or with your club, as it can vary slightly.

sections.heading: No Exit Fees
sections.body: One of the genuine advantages of Jetts is the absence of lock-in contracts and exit fees. There's no penalty for cancelling. If you joined Jetts specifically because of the no-contract flexibility, the cancellation process reflects exactly that — straightforward and penalty-free.

sections.heading: If You Have a Problem
sections.body:
Jetts cancellations are generally smooth, but if you encounter issues:
- Always get written confirmation of your cancellation
- If you're being charged after your confirmed cancellation date, contact your club directly
- If unresolved, raise a direct debit dispute with your bank
- Escalate to Jetts NZ support if your club doesn't respond

faq.question: How do I cancel Jetts NZ?
faq.answer: Log into the Jetts member portal and submit a cancellation, or visit your club in person. There's no lock-in contract, so you just serve the notice period (typically 10–14 days) and your membership ends.

faq.question: Is there a cancellation fee for Jetts NZ?
faq.answer: No — Jetts NZ has no lock-in contract and no exit fees. You just need to give the required notice period.

faq.question: How much notice do you need to cancel Jetts NZ?
faq.answer: Typically 10–14 days written notice. Check your membership agreement for the exact period at your club.
